entities.name: Pool of Knowledge
entities.description: Torus-shaped vat of Blinkmoth Serum in Lumengrid used by vedalken to mutate and gain revelations.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: Mirrodin people who used the pool.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Advent after which the pool became partially sentient.

events.summary: With the advent of New Phyrexia the pool becomes partially sentient and falls under Phyrexian corruption.
events.quote: the pool became partially sentient, and immediately fell under the corruption of the Phyrexians

events.summary: The vedalken elite decide to keep the pool's corruption secret.
events.quote: the vedalken elite decided to keep this knowledge a secret
